name: Muse Wonder
short: Meta Superintelligence Labs' preview multimodal model (1M ctx, $4/$20 per M) for agentic and coding work; API model muse-wonder-1.0, not Muse Wonder Full.
pricingNote: $4 input / $20 output per M; cached input $0.20 per M; web search $2.50 per 1,000 queries
pricingTiers: Standard: $4 input / $20 output / $0.20 cached input per M
standout: Strong coding (DeepSWE/SWE-Marathon) and multimodal input support with a 1M-token context.
tradeoff: Expensive $4/$20 rate and preview status; no published retrieval result validating the full 1M context.
